commands.text: The humming leaves the air before the crowd remembers how to speak at its usual volume.

commands.speaker: tw_lantern_carrier
commands.text: I heard mine with the valley’s. I have never heard it like that.

commands.speaker: thistle_roe
commands.text: Sit for a moment. You do not have to stand while you find the words.

commands.speaker: clem_marr
commands.text: I will write that the rim flickered and the bells answered together.

commands.speaker: vespera_wisp
commands.text: And keep the explanation beside it, rather than inside the observation.

commands.speaker: tw_guide
commands.text: We go down in small groups. The road has not become wider because everyone wants it now.
